style: Storybook illustration from a luxurious classic Japanese children's picture book. Hand-painted watercolor and gouache on cream textured paper, delicate sepia ink linework, soft visible brush strokes, paper grain, gentle warm light, rich red and amber autumn palette, elegant, magical, cozy. Vertical composition, the upper third is calm open sky. No text, no letters, no people

items.name: hiru
items.prompt: An old Kyoto temple on a forested hillside in late autumn daytime: a small slender vermilion two-storied pagoda peeks out above a sea of red and orange maple trees on the hill, below it long curved dark-tiled temple roofs and a covered wooden corridor climbing the slope, a winding stone path in the foreground, pale blue sky with soft clouds

items.name: aki
items.prompt: A quiet temple pond in Kyoto framed by blazing red, orange and golden maple trees, a small arched stone bridge across the water, the tip of a vermilion pagoda above the treetops on the hill, red maple leaves floating on the still water, warm late afternoon sunlight

items.name: yoru
items.prompt: Night illumination at a Kyoto temple garden: red maple trees lit warmly from below glow against a deep indigo starry sky and are mirrored perfectly in a still dark pond, a softly lit vermilion pagoda on the dark hillside above, small stone lanterns with golden light along the shore
